systems.owner: Government with operators under a public-private partnership; World Bank Digital Sao Tome and Principe project (P177158)
systems.tiers: inter-island link between São Tomé and Príncipe; supply contract not signed and cable not operational at 19 September 2025; no local government office said to be on it

note: The project connects islands and 70 educational institutions (none yet at 19 September 2025) and builds a national interoperability platform with no government system connected; it names no local government office, and 'municipality' appears only as a disaggregation of census population counts.
